title: Instant Steal Chicken, Insane Chickens, More
features:
[ STEAL ENGINE ]

• Auto Steal & Escape (Glides, steals, escapes to start position)

• Anti-Rubberband System (Legal speed transition near nests)

• Night Cycle Auto-Pause & Resume

• Cluster Dwell Scanner (3s-5s scan after escape)

• Target Priority: Nearest, Rarest First, Heaviest First, Highest Zone

• Zone Filters: All 11 zones (Forest -> Crystal) + Quick Presets

• Steal Filters: Rarities (Common to Secret), Mega Only, Min Weight (kg)

[ BACKPACK & SELLING ]

• Auto Sell when Backpack Limit is reached

• Selective Selling: All, Pets Only, Eggs Only

• Sell Filters: Insane Only, Mega Only, Min Weight

• Instant Sell Button

[ BASE AUTOMATION ]

• Auto Claim Pen Eggs

• Auto Upgrade Base Level

• Auto Equip Best Chickens

• Auto Claim Playtime Gifts (1-12)

[ TRAINING & UPGRADES ]

• Auto Train on Base Treadmill

• Auto Upgrade Treadmill Tier

• Auto Upgrade Speed Multiplier

[ COMBAT & PROTECTION ]

• Bat Kill Aura (Auto-attack nearby players)

• Customizable Aura Radius Slider

[ CHARACTER MODS & ESP ]

• WalkSpeed Changer with Anti-Cheat Bypass

• Infinite Jump & NoClip

• Nest & Chicken ESP (Custom Billboard & Highlight)

• Player ESP

• Live HUD Dashboard (Money, Speed, Backpack, Base, Treadmill)
